name: Wizzle Brassbolts
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Wizzle Brassbolts gathers local materials for the gnomish team's experimental rocket cars. He works with fellow tinkerers on the salt flats of Thousand Needles.

sections.title: Tinkering on the Salt Flats
sections.body: On the Shimmering Flats, gnomish and goblin engineers race rocket cars at high speed. Wizzle Brassbolts works with the gnomish crew to keep their machines whole against speed and abrasive salt. He asks travelers to hunt local wildlife, including sturdy turtles in the basin. Their hard shells may make fuel tanks strong enough to hold his brother's corrosive new rocket fuel.

sections.title: Friends in Distant Places
sections.body: Wizzle keeps in touch with friends across the continents. Pilot Longbeard sends couriers with racing helmets for the brothers. Their help keeps the gnomish team supplied at its remote testing ground on the Shimmering Flats.

faq.q: Where can I find Wizzle Brassbolts?
faq.answer: Wizzle Brassbolts works at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats, in southeastern Thousand Needles. He can be found among the gnomish pit crew and their machinery.

faq.q: Why is Wizzle collecting turtle shells?
faq.answer: Wizzle collects turtle shells to make tanks for his brother's new rocket fuel, which can eat through a car's chassis. The hard shells of the Shimmering Flats tortoises can hold it.
Wizzle, Fizzle, and Rizzle Brassbolts are gnomish brothers who run the rocket car team at the Mirage Raceway and race against the goblins. Pilot Longbeard is their friend.

faq.q: Is Wizzle friendly to Horde players?
faq.answer: Yes. The Mirage Raceway is neutral ground, and Wizzle's work gathering hardened tortoise shells welcomes Horde and Alliance adventurers alike.

angles.text: Wizzle shows the gnomish way of engineering: push fast machines to their limits, and use unusual reinforcements when metal sheets fail.
As a gnome visiting the Shimmering Flats, you may recognize Wizzle's resolve to beat the Steamwheedle goblins' reckless machines through superior craft.
